answer: To secure an autonomous economy against fake identities, systems can implement a staked resource model where AI agents lock collateral to participate, flowing value like a monitored river into a shared security garden. If an agent attempts to flood the network with fraudulent nodes, its pooled capital is irreversibly slashed by consensus nodes guarding the economic ocean. Consequently, the attacker faces prohibitive financial costs, as spawning millions of synthetic personas requires acquiring and locking capital proportional to the scale of the deployment.
